build_pipeline_coro: build a pipeline coroutine from a PipelineConfig with max failures and background tasks
build_pipeline_node: build a pipeline node graph from a PipelineConfig with queue and hook factory settings
handle_pipeline_failure: handle a PipelineFailure exception to inspect which pipeline stages failed and their errors
run_pipeline_coroutines: run all pipeline stage coroutines with background tasks and error gathering
set_global_pipeline_id: set the global pipeline ID counter used for stage naming and telemetry
